description: This file contains helper functions and tests related to encoding conversions, specifically for UTF-16 and UTF-32 encodings using iconv, as well as prerequisites tests to check for BOM support.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-16 BOM if prerequisite not met, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-16 using iconv.

methods.name: write_utf32
methods.description: Outputs the UTF-32 BOM if prerequisite not met, then converts input from UTF-8 to UTF-32 using iconv.
